QuestInfo.name: Making Legendary Maple Syrup
QuestInfo.0: Gaga wants to try making Legendary Maple Syrup, and needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Legendary Maple Syrup is made by staying logged in for 30 minutes with Maple Syrup from Gaga in your inventory. Pretty simple.
QuestInfo.2: What do you suppose fruit juice mixed with Legendary Maple Syrup tastes like...?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: 1 Legends Awards Coin (Up to 3 per day), Syrupy-Sweet Buff (HP and Weapon/Magic Defense increase based on level)
